title: Pilot should have a structured game log built from GameView diffs
description:
The pilot currently gets raw XMage text via get_game_log. An initial attempt to add structure (PR #556) wrapped XMage's chat messages in a parallel list, but this was fundamentally wrong: XMage drops chat messages under contention (50ms lock timeout in Session.fireCallback), making the stream nondeterministic. It also gave us no control over content — we were just wrapping XMage's verbose text.

The correct approach: diff consecutive GameView snapshots from GAME_UPDATE callbacks. The bridge already receives full GameView objects on every state change. By comparing prev vs curr GameView, we can reliably detect zone transitions (cards entering/leaving battlefield, graveyard, stack), life total changes, combat, permanent state changes, etc. This gives us a complete, reliable, token-efficient structured history with full semantic control.

See doc/game-history-design.md for detailed design notes including GameView fields, diffing strategy, and open questions.
